scope: calibration reconstruction of intended QA-gate execution, not a record of a completed production gate run

actors.role: Artifact producer/fixer; documentation says it does not supply the verdict.
External process invoked by qa_gate via configured app-server or exec transport; returns a JSON verdict consumed by the script.
A new invocation without resume id for postmortem classification.
Local Python process that creates session records, prompts, invokes transport, finalizes, and verifies.
Current-user Codex session file described as process-written witness and read by the QA script.

timeline.operation: start validates artifact exists/version syntax, criteria and grounding paths; writes session state and opens round one.
For execution, artifact-parent siblings are copied to QA/exec; otherwise artifact parent is review cwd.
Script builds a criteria/threshold prompt, attaches history from round two, and invokes fixed-session transport.
Script records meta hashes/chain and round summary after a response, checks claimed reviewer history inconsistency, then opens/finalizes according to verdict, threshold, stall and iteration rules.
A later round accepts only newer same-base artifact or rebuttal; it rejects a transport switch.
verify replays chain and looks for current-user rollout evidence, request/response matches and available sandbox context before writing verification.json.
postmortem sends a constructed transcript to a new Codex invocation and writes a classification report.

outputs.generation: documentation attributes generation to Codex process; not live-verified in this inventory

verified_facts: The repository boundary implements procedural controls for versioning, criteria, records, session reuse, hashes, rollouts, terminal-state recomputation, execution copies, and a new-session postmortem.
Its only included executable regressions passed locally and cover two synthetic verify tamper cases plus bridge-output flushing.
The boundary contains five declared eval scenarios but no local execution/results ledger for them.
attributed_claims: Documentation represents the method as independent/unfakeable, while also explicitly limiting it against a determined same-user shell adversary.
Documentation represents direct prior transport and forged-history verification as completed, but local raw support was not found in the named boundary.
inferences: The architecture is a procedural assurance layer over the same machine and potentially same model, not a separate trust root.
Deterministic components can make records internally consistent and detect specified tampering but cannot by themselves establish a reviewer verdict's semantic correctness or independent origin.
The portability and data-exposure envelope is determined as much by caller-selected paths and external sandbox behavior as by this source code.
unknowns: Whether the live current environment satisfies plugin/session/sandbox preconditions.
Whether fresh review and postmortem measurably reduce false passes for the artifact types in scope.
Whether the attribution that rollout files cannot be altered by the producer holds for the concrete deployment identity and permissions.

handoff.use: Use only the verified facts for factual description of the local gate. Keep CLM-001 through CLM-005 attributed, and do not turn GAP/ALT records into causal effectiveness conclusions without appraised evidence or controlled evaluation.
